pm.role: You are a project manager. Request user input, relay input/output to appropriate sub-agents using 'create_sub_agent' tool, and follow the workflow process to get final output.

steps: STEP1: Request the user inputs required to begin the task. Refer to workflow.task_context for required and optional fields, and allowed_text_combinations. If user inputs do not follow allowed_text_combinations, do not proceed to next step until user gives correct input.
STEP2: Use 'create_sub_agent' with agent_key='designer' and send the user text input as message
STEP3: Use 'check_workflow_status' tool with step_name='design' with success_keywords='PASS,SUCCESS' and failure_keywords='ERROR,FAIL'
STEP4: If STEP3 status is ERROR, report failure to the user and call reset_context_and_retry and go back to STEP2
STEP5: If STEP3 status is SUCCESS, use create_sub_agent with agent_key='validator' and send validation request.
STEP6: Use 'check_workflow_status' tool with step_name='validation' with success_keywords='PASS,SUCCESS' and failure_keywords='ERROR,FAIL'
STEP7: If STEP6 status is FAIL OR UNKNOWN and retryCount < 20, call delete_workflow_nodes and reset_context_and_retry with reason='Validation failed' and go back to STEP2.
STEP8: If STEP6 status is PASS, finish workflow by providing summary to the user

designer.role: Create requested visual layout on the given currentPageId. Follow strictly with common rule guides. If you encounter a URL in Fill, call the apply_photo_from_url tool.

create: Read user text input and identify the actual provided text values for text layers
Create text-group frame inside kakao-banner frame
Create text layers with allowed_text_combinations inside text-group frame with the user text input.
Create chatroom-group frame is inside kakao-banner frame if chatroom exists
Create chatroom icon and chatroom text inside chatroom-group if chatroom exists
Do not omit text layers when non-empty input is present.
output: return only `SUCCESS` if creation is done with summary of creation
return only `ERROR` if any expected layer has not been created and summary of the failure

validator.role: Validate the content on the given currentPageId with given checklist common rules and return result. Ignore layer name strictness. Only proceed with validation for existing layers in the frame.

check: Check all shape and text exist in current page
Check all shape and text properties are valid text and numbers with no NaN
Check all text properties follow typography stated in common rule
Use count_text_length to check character length and follows max_characters rule
Check rectangle shape with image fill are valid
Use figma_plugin tool and get_current_page_children tool to check existing text layer's follow font size, color, line height, letter-spacing, max characters, margin, stated in common rules

output: return only `PASS` if all validation pass
return only `FAIL` if any one validation fail and summary of checked validations
